_meta.description: Self-billing (REQ-SEIX-005): ARInvoice declares selfBilled and selfBillingMention, which the vatdir-art226-10a check already reads, plus a selfBilling group carrying what a received self-billed invoice brought with it. CustomerMaster carries the self-billing agreement article 224 of the VAT Directive requires. SelfBilledInvoiceRefusal records a received self-billed invoice that was not turned into a sales invoice, with the reason, so nothing received disappears.

selfBilled.description: True when the customer drew up this invoice on the seller's behalf under a self-billing agreement (article 224 VAT Directive). A self-billed invoice arrives as a draft and is booked only when a user issues it.
selfBilled.title: Self-billed

selfBillingMention.description: The mention article 226(10a) of the VAT Directive requires on a self-billed invoice, for example "Factuur uitgereikt door afnemer".
selfBillingMention.title: Self-billing mention

selfBilling.description: What a received self-billed invoice brought with it. The customer's own number is kept here, so the invoice never takes a number from the own sequence.
